region: EU (DE/AT price comparison; Alternate DE retail)
notes: Prices are the lowest listed EU offer on the date shown, not a quote. Stock and price move daily.
The 2026 DRAM/NAND shortage dominates this BOM: 2x64 GB RDIMM is 49% of the platform cost.
GPUs are owned by the user and excluded from platform totals; their replacement value is shown separately.
Fan prices are estimates; everything else is a listed price from the source shown.

mainboard.name: GIGABYTE TRX50 AI TOP (sTR5, E-ATX, 4x PCIe 5.0 x16, 4x M.2, 8x DDR5 RDIMM)
mainboard.note: Alternate lists 877.00 but cannot currently sell it.

cpu.name: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9955WX (16C/32T, 4.5-5.4 GHz, 350 W, 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes, 8-channel DDR5 ECC)
cpu.note: MSRP $1,649. Alternate lists 1,715.00 but cannot currently sell it.

ram_64gb.name: Samsung M321R8GA0PB0-CWM 64 GB DDR5-5600 CL46 2Rx4 ECC RDIMM
ram_64gb.note: 2 DIMMs = 2 of 8 channels now; 8 DIMMs = 512 GB octa-channel later.

nvme_1tb.name: Samsung 990 PRO 1 TB (PCIe 4.0 x4, 7,450/6,900 MB/s, 1.2M/1.55M IOPS)
nvme_1tb.note: Gen4 chosen over Gen5: cooler under the GPUs, cheaper, and the PLE table reads are random, not sequential.

sata_4tb.name: Samsung 870 EVO 4 TB SATA SSD
sata_4tb.note: Listed price, currently not orderable at Alternate. Cold archive + OS partition; 500 GB SATA is 203.90, so the 4 TB is the better EUR/GB.

psu.name: Seasonic PRIME PX-2200 (2200 W, ATX 3.1, 80+ Platinum, 2x native 12V-2x6 + 2x 2x8-pin adapters, 4x PCIe 8-pin, 3x EPS)
psu.note: 200-240 V only. 210 mm long. 2200 W gives 26% headroom over the 1630 W continuous budget.

cooler_air.name: Noctua NH-U14S TR5-SP6 (165 mm air cooler for sTR5)
cooler_air.note: Fine for bursty inference; the AIO is better for sustained all-core + 4 GPU heat.

cooler_aio.name: SilverStone SST-XE360-TR5 (360 mm AIO, sTR5/SP6, 350 W class)
cooler_aio.note: Top-mounted exhaust in the Meshify 2 XL; keeps CPU heat out of the GPU intake.

case_meshify.name: Fractal Design Meshify 2 XL (E-ATX/SSI-EEB, 9 slots, 6x 3.5", 3x 140 mm included, 480 mm top rad, 250 mm PSU)
case_meshify.note: 9 slots = four 2-slot GPUs with a spare; SSI-EEB is the 305x330 mm board. Listed price, stock varies.

case_9000d.name: Corsair iCUE LINK 9000D Airflow (E-ATX, 8 slots, 5x 3.5", 6x 2.5")
case_9000d.note: More room for cable/PSU service; listed price, stock varies.

case_enthoo.name: Phanteks Enthoo Pro 2 (E-ATX, 8 slots, 4x 3.5", 11x 2.5")
case_enthoo.note: Budget alternate; verify 305x330 mm board and 210 mm PSU clearance before ordering.

fan_140.name: 140 mm PWM case fan (Fractal/Arctic class)
fan_140.note: Case includes 3x 140 mm; add bottom/rear fans for the M.2 and GPU zone.

gpu_r9700.name: PowerColor Radeon AI PRO R9700 32 GB (2-slot blower, 267x111x40 mm, 300 W, 1x 12V-2x6)
gpu_r9700.note: OWNED by the user. Shown only as replacement value; not in platform totals.

A.tagline: Lowest cost per token; air cooling; one 4 TB SATA

C.tagline: 4x64 GB now (quad-channel, 8x path), bigger case, RAID1 cold archive
